Model.Name: UnitLinkedModelCF
Model.Notes: Product cashflow layer - contains Product logic and decremented Cashflows.

Parameter.Name: AIDS
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — This parameter stores numeric values with decimal precision. Source: RunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup table used for model configuration.

Parameter.Name: AccidentalMortality
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — This parameter stores a single numeric value with high decimal precision. Source: RunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup table used for model configuration.

Parameter.Name: CUDiscounting
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Stores text values, typically used to reference a discounting method or curve. Source: RunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup table.

Parameter.Name: CriticalIllness
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the critical illness benefit amount or loading applied within the product setup. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup configuration table.

Parameter.Name: DecrementBasis
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the decrement assumption set used in the model run. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup table defining base decrement assumptions.

Parameter.Name: Expense
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the expense loading or rate applied in model runs. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup defining base expense assumptions.

Parameter.Name: ExpenseBasis
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the expense basis table or assumption reference used in the model. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is taken from the parent setup table linking to the expense basis configuration.

Parameter.Name: ExpenseInflation
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the inflation rate applied to expense projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup table used for inflation adjustments in modeling.

Parameter.Name: InflationYC
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the inflation yield curve used for economic projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup table defining inflation curve references.

Parameter.Name: LIYCRun
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Indicates the logical run identifier for life insurance yield curve simulations. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup table to control execution sequencing.

Parameter.Name: Lapses
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the lapse rate or assumption applied to policy terminations. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup defining lapse assumptions for projection runs.

Parameter.Name: MPFName
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the MPF assumption set used for model runs. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup table specifying the MPF configuration name.

Parameter.Name: MorbidityCATIndicator
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Indicates whether morbidity catastrophe adjustments are active in the model. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the run setup table controlling morbidity CAT inclusion flags.

Parameter.Name: Mortality
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the mortality rate or assumption used in actuarial projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup table defining mortality parameters for projections.

Parameter.Name: MortalityCATIndicator
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Acts as a flag indicating the inclusion of mortality catastrophe adjustments in the model. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup configuration controlling mortality CAT indicators.

Parameter.Name: NBMarker
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Indicates the new business marker for model run identification. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the run setup table used to distinguish new business model executions.

Parameter.Name: NaturalMortality
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the natural mortality rate used in actuarial projections excluding accidental causes. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the run setup configuration defining natural death assumptions.

Parameter.Name: NextValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Specifies the date of the next valuation cycle. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is derived from the run setup table defining the timing for the subsequent valuation period.

Parameter.Name: NominalYC
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the nominal yield curve reference used in the valuation run. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is retrieved from the run setup table specifying yield curve naming conventions.

Parameter.Name: Parent
Parameter.Notes: DataType: IModel — Defines the parent model reference within the run setup configuration. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The parameter points to the primary actuarial model instance used for the current reporting run.

Parameter.Name: PermanentDisability
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the calculated rate or value associated with permanent disability events. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The parameter value is sourced from the run setup table containing core assumptions for decrement analysis.

Parameter.Name: PolicyStartLevel
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Indicates the starting policy level value used for actuarial or pricing calculations. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value originates from the run setup table storing key initialization parameters for valuation runs.

Parameter.Name: RegulatoryExpenseBasis
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Defines the regulatory expense basis applied during statutory or compliance valuation runs. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is derived from the run setup table storing configuration for regulatory reporting assumptions.

Parameter.Name: Retrenchment
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the retrenchment decrement rate applied in actuarial projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Derived from the parent run setup table storing retrenchment assumptions for modeling policy terminations.

Parameter.Name: RunOutputNextValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Specifies the next valuation date for output reporting in YYYY/MM/DD format. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The parameter is sourced from the run setup table and determines the upcoming financial or actuarial reporting cycle.

Parameter.Name: RunOutputValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Represents the valuation date for model output generation. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Used as the reporting date reference for the current run of actuarial results.

Parameter.Name: RunSetupTblPrm
Parameter.Notes: DataType: TableStr — Refers to the table containing parameterized run setup configurations. Source: RunControlTbl — Used for controlling run-level settings and environment configuration across multiple simulations.

Parameter.Name: RunType
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Describes the type of actuarial or reporting run being performed (e.g., closing, projection, or sensitivity test). Source: prmRunSetupTbl — This identifies the specific run configuration and context for reporting.

Parameter.Name: ShockDuration
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Specifies the duration (in months or years) of applied stress or shock in scenario testing. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Used for sensitivity and resilience testing across actuarial projections.

Parameter.Name: TemporaryDisability
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the temporary disability rate or assumption used in the valuation. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Defined in the run setup parameters for use in modeling temporary disability decrements.

Parameter.Name: TerminalIllness
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Reflects the terminal illness rate or assumption used in actuarial modeling. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Defined in the run setup parameters to drive terminal illness decrement or claim probability calculations.

Parameter.Name: ValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Represents the valuation date used for financial and actuarial reporting. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Derived from the run setup parameters indicating the effective date for the model valuation.

Formula.Name: AccumUnitFMChge
Formula.Value:
Dim chge_perc As Double
If CapUnitPeriodStatus(t) = 0 Then chge_perc = SMCoreModel.FMChge_AccumUnit / 12 Else chge_perc = 0 End If
Return AccumUnitFVPreFMCharges(t) * chge_perc

Formula.Name: AccumUnitFVBOM
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If ValMonth(t) < 0 Then Return 0 Else If ValMonth(t) = 0 Then Return SMCoreModel.InitAccumUnitFV Else Return AccumUnitFVEOM(t - 1) End If End If

Formula.Name: AccumUnitFVEOM
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return (AccumUnitFVPreFMCharges(t) - AccumUnitFMChge(t)) End If

Formula.Name: AccumUnitFVPreFMCharges
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return Math.Max(0, AccumUnitFVBOM(t) + (1 - CapUnitPeriodStatus(t)) * (ExpectedPremInvested(t) - MortChge(t) - SurrChge(t)) + AccumUnitInvReturn(t) - AccumUnitInvExp(t)) End If

Formula.Name: AccumUnitInvExp
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return AccumUnitInvReturn(t) * SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc End If

Formula.Name: AccumUnitInvReturn
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return (AccumUnitFVBOM(t) + (1 - CapUnitPeriodStatus(t)) * (ExpectedPremInvested(t)) ) * FinalFundGthPCMth(t) End If

Formula.Name: AllocatedPrem
Formula.Value: Return (Prem(t) - MonthlyPolFee(t)) * AllocationPercFunc(t)

Formula.Name: AllocationPercFunc
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.OpenEndIndicator = 1 Then Return 1 ElseIf t >= SMCoreModel.Allocation_Rate_ConstantRateStart_t Then Return SMCoreModel.Allocation_rate_tbl.Value(CInt(SMCoreModel.Allocation_Rate_ConstantRateStart_t), SMCoreModel.ProductName) Else Return SMCoreModel.Allocation_rate_tbl.Value(t, SMCoreModel.ProductName) End If End If

Formula.Name: BalDate
Formula.Value: 'Return GetBalDate(t - PeriodIF(), SMCoreModel.ValnDate, StepsPY) Return SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)

Formula.Name: BidOfferSpread
Formula.Value: Return AllocatedPrem(t) * SMCoreModel.BoS

Formula.Name: CapUnitFMChge
Formula.Value:
Dim chge_perc As Double
If CapUnitPeriodStatus(t) = 1 Then chge_perc = SMCoreModel.FMChge_CapUnit / 12 Else chge_perc = 0 End If
Return CapUnitFVPreFMCharges(t) * chge_perc

Formula.Name: CapUnitFVBOM
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If ValMonth(t) < 0 Then Return 0 Else If ValMonth(t) = 0 Then Return SMCoreModel.InitCapUnitFV Else Return CapUnitFVEOM(t - 1) End If End If

Formula.Name: CapUnitFVEOM
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return (CapUnitFVPreFMCharges(t) - CapUnitFMChge(t)) End If

Formula.Name: CapUnitFVPreFMCharges
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return Math.Max(0, CapUnitFVBOM(t) + CapUnitPeriodStatus(t) * (ExpectedPremInvested(t) - MortChge(t) - SurrChge(t)) + CapUnitInvReturn(t) - CapUnitInvExp(t)) End If

Formula.Name: CapUnitInvExp
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return CapUnitInvReturn(t) * SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc End If

Formula.Name: CapUnitInvReturn
Formula.Value: If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else Return (CapUnitFVBOM(t) + CapUnitPeriodStatus(t) * (ExpectedPremInvested(t))) * FinalFundGthPCMth(t) End If

Formula.Name: CapUnitPeriodStatus
Formula.Value: If t <= SMCoreModel.CapUnitFundPeriod Then Return 1 Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedAMCIncome
Formula.Value: Return (AccumUnitFMChge(t) + CapUnitFMChge(t)) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedAccidentalDeath
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_PRO(t) + Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_Fam_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedAquisitionAAW
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedBoS
Formula.Value: Return BidOfferSpread(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedCashbackBenefit
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedClaimExpPerClaim
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPerClaim_func(t) * (SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_PRO(t))

Formula.Name: ExpectedClaimPercClaimAmt
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_func(t) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedComissionClawback
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Comission_Clawback_func(t) * SMCoreModel.Lapses_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedCriticalIllness
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedDeath
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.ProductDescription = EndowmentLien Then If SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) <= SMCoreModel.Guaranteed_benefit_min_term Then Return Math.Max(0, GuaranteedBenefit(t) - MonthlyPolFee(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) ElseIf SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) >= SMCoreModel.Death_EndowLien_ConstantRateStart_yrs Then Dim DeathBenAmount As Double = SMCoreModel.Sum_assured_factor * SMCoreModel.UL_endowment_lien_perc_sa_benefit.Value(CInt(SMCoreModel.Death_EndowLien_ConstantRateStart_yrs), SMCoreModel.ProductName) * SMCoreModel.InitialPremium / SMCoreModel.PremiumFrequency Return Math.Max(0, DeathBenAmount - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) Else Dim DeathBenAmount As Double = SMCoreModel.Sum_assured_factor * SMCoreModel.UL_endowment_lien_perc_sa_benefit.Value(CInt(SMCoreModel.PolYear(t)), SMCoreModel.ProductName) * SMCoreModel.InitialPremium / SMCoreModel.PremiumFrequency Return Math.Max(0, DeathBenAmount - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) End If ElseIf SMCoreModel.ProductDescription = AssetBuilder Then Dim DeathBenAmount As Double = 96 * SMCoreModel.InitialPremium / SMCoreModel.PremiumFrequency Return Math.Max(0, DeathBenAmount - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) ElseIf SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) <> 0 Then Return Math.Max(0, Math.Max(SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t), GuaranteedBenefit(t)) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) Else Return Math.Max(0, GuaranteedBenefit(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedFuneral
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedInitExpPerPrem
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Then Return 0 Return SMCoreModel.InitialExpPercPremium_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedInitExpensePP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.InitialExpPP_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedInitialCommission
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Initial_Comission_Func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedMaturity
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.Outstanding_term(t) = 1 Then Return (Math.Max(0, GuaranteedBenefit(t) - SMCoreModel.PremiumBalance - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Maturity_PRO(t)) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedMortChgeIncome
Formula.Value: Return MortChge(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedNaturalDeath
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_PRO(t) + Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_Fam_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedPPE
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Per_pol_exp_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPaidUp
Formula.Value: Return ULPaidUpCover(t) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) * 0

Formula.Name: ExpectedPartialSurrender
Formula.Value: Return ULPartialSurrenderCover(t) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) * 0

Formula.Name: ExpectedPercCUExpense
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Perc_CU_exp_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPercPremExpense
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Perc_premium_exp_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPermanentDisability
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedPolFeeWithInfl
Formula.Value: Return MonthlyPolFee(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedPremInvested
Formula.Value: Return (AllocatedPrem(t) - BidOfferSpread(t)) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedRenewalComission
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Renewal_Comission_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedRetrenchment
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedSurrChgeIncome
Formula.Value: Return SurrChge(t) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedSurrender
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, ULSurrenderCover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedTemporaryDisability
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedTerminalIllness
Formula.Value: Return Math.Max(0, SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_cover(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedUnallocatedPrem
Formula.Value: If PeriodIF() < 0 Then Return 0 Else Return (Prem(t) * NonUnitAllocPerc(t)) * HealthyPROBOM(t) End If

Formula.Name: FinalFundGthPCMth
Formula.Value:
Dim i As Double
If SMCoreModel.UnitFund_growth_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then i = UnitGthPCMth() ElseIf SMCoreModel.UnitFund_growth_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Yield_curve Then i = NomEscalation(t) End If
Return Math.Max(i, GuaranteedGthPCMth())

Formula.Name: GuaranteedBenefit
Formula.Notes: Currently uses value of accumulation fund to calculate guaranteed benefit.
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return SMCoreModel.InitGuaranteedUnitFV Else Return (1 + GuaranteedGthPCMth()) * Math.Max(TotalUnitFVBOM(t - 1), GuaranteedBenefit(t - 1) + ExpectedPremInvested(t)) End If Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: GuaranteedGthPCMth
Formula.Value: Return (1 + SMCoreModel.Guaranteed_unit_growth_perc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1

Formula.Name: HealthyPROBOM
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Or t = 0 Then Return 1 Else Return SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) End If

Formula.Name: HealthyPROEOM
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: InflationEscalation
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return (1 + Economic_curves.Value(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t + 1)), SMCoreModel.Inf_input())) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 End If

Formula.Name: MonthlyPolFee
Formula.Value:
Dim z As Double Dim freq_month_ind As Double Dim modnum As Double
If PeriodIF() < 0 Then Return 0 Else If AllocationPercFunc(t) > 0 If SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then If Month(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t))) = Month(SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate) Then z = (SMCoreModel.Policy_fee_amt / 12) * (1 + PolFeeInfl(t)) ^ (12 * SMCoreModel.PolYear(t)) Else z = MonthlyPolFee(t - 1) End If ElseIf SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Yield_curve Then z = (SMCoreModel.Policy_fee_amt / 12) * (1 + PolFeeInfl(t)) ^ 1 Else z = MonthlyPolFee(t - 1) End If End If
Return z

Formula.Name: MortChge
Formula.Value:
'***MUST UPDATE THE ASSUMPTION WHEN CLIENT CONFIRMS INPUT Dim NoMortChgePeriod As Integer = 1
If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Or SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) < NoMortChgePeriod Then Return 0 Else Return SumAtRisk(t) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: NomEscalation
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return (1 + Economic_curves.Value(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)), SMCoreModel.Nom_input()) + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 End If

Formula.Name: NonUnitAllocPerc
Formula.Value: If AllocationPercFunc(t) = 0 Then Return 1 Else Return 1 - AllocationPercFunc(t) End If

Formula.Name: NonUnitBOM
Formula.Value: If PeriodIF() < 0 Then Return 0 Else Return (ExpectedInitialCommission(t) + ExpectedRenewalComission(t) _ + ExpectedInitExpensePP(t) + ExpectedInitExpPerPrem(t) _ + ExpectedPPE(t) + ExpectedPercPremExpense(t) _ + ExpectedPercCUExpense(t) + ExpectedAquisitionAAW(t) _ + ExpectedCashbackBenefit(t) _ - ExpectedUnallocatedPrem(t) - ExpectedPolFeeWithInfl(t) _ - ExpectedBoS(t) - ExpectedMortChgeIncome(t) _ - ExpectedSurrChgeIncome(t) - ExpectedComissionClawback(t) _ ) End If

Formula.Name: NonUnitEOM
Formula.Value: If PeriodIF() < 0 Then Return 0 Else Return (ExpectedDeath(t) + ExpectedSurrender(t) _ + ExpectedPartialSurrender(t) + ExpectedPaidUp(t) _ + ExpectedMaturity(t) + ExpectedClaimPercClaimAmt(t) _ + ExpectedClaimExpPerClaim(t) + ExpectedAccidentalDeath(t) + ExpectedNaturalDeath(t) _ + ExpectedPermanentDisability(t) + ExpectedTerminalIllness(t) + ExpectedTemporaryDisability(t) _ + ExpectedRetrenchment(t) + ExpectedCriticalIllness(t) + ExpectedFuneral(t) _ - ExpectedAMCIncome(t) ) End If

Formula.Name: PeriodIF
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: PolFeeInfl
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then Return (1 + SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 ElseIf SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Yield_curve Then Return InflationEscalation(t) Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: Prem
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t)

Formula.Name: ProjTerm
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ProjTerm

Formula.Name: SumAtRisk
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If t < PeriodIF() Then Return 0 ElseIf PeriodIF() > 0 And t = PeriodIF() + 1 Then Return Math.Max(0, GuaranteedBenefit(t) - MonthlyPolFee(t) - TotalInitUnitFV()) ElseIf t > 0 Then Return Math.Max(0, GuaranteedBenefit(t) - MonthlyPolFee(t) - TotalUnitFVEOM(t - 1)) End If End If

Formula.Name: SurrChge
Formula.Value:
Dim Surr_ben_local As Double Dim YearLU As Integer
YearLU = Math.Min(CInt(SMCoreModel.PolYear(t)), CInt(SMCoreModel.Surr_ConstantRateStart_yrs))
Surr_ben_local = SMCoreModel.Surrender_benefits_tbl.Value(YearLU, SMCoreModel.ProductName)
If t < PeriodIF() Or t > ProjTerm() Then Return 0 Else If SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) >= SMCoreModel.Surr_ConstantRateStart_yrs And Surr_ben_local > 0 Then Return (TotalUnitFVBOM(t) - ULSurrenderCover(t)) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) ' Return (1 - Surr_ben_local) * Math.Max(SumAtRisk(t), AccumUnitFVBOM(t) + CapUnitFVBOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) Else If Surr_ben_local > 0 Then Return (TotalUnitFVBOM(t) - ULSurrenderCover(t)) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) ' Return (1 - Surr_ben_local) * Math.Max(SumAtRisk(t), AccumUnitFVBOM(t) + CapUnitFVBOM(t)) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: TotalInitUnitFV
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.InitAccumUnitFV + SMCoreModel.InitCapUnitFV

Formula.Name: TotalUnitFVBOM
Formula.Value: Return (AccumUnitFVBOM(t) + CapUnitFVBOM(t)) * HealthyPROBOM(t)

Formula.Name: TotalUnitFVEOM
Formula.Value: Return (AccumUnitFVEOM(t) + CapUnitFVEOM(t))

Formula.Name: ULPaidUpCover
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" If SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) >= SMCoreModel.PaidUp_ConstantRateStart_yrs Then Return SMCoreModel.PaidUp_benefits_tbl.Value(CInt(SMCoreModel.PaidUp_ConstantRateStart_yrs), SMCoreModel.ProductName) * TotalUnitFVBOM(t) * (1 + FinalFundGthPCMth(t)) Else Return SMCoreModel.PaidUp_benefits_tbl.Value(CInt(SMCoreModel.PolYear(t)), SMCoreModel.ProductName) * TotalUnitFVBOM(t) * (1 + FinalFundGthPCMth(t)) End If Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: ULPartialSurrenderCover
Formula.Value: If t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) > SMCoreModel.Partial_surrender_min_pol_years Then Return SMCoreModel.Partial_surrender_perc_unitFV * TotalUnitFVBOM(t) End If End If

Formula.Name: ULSurrenderCover
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_factor(t) * TotalUnitFVBOM(t)

Formula.Name: UnitGthPCMth
Formula.Value: Return (1 + SMCoreModel.UnitFund_growth_perc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1

Formula.Name: ValMonth
Formula.Value: Return t - PeriodIF()
